caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, specifically a spur, placed against a plain, light-colored background. The main band of the spur is gold or yellow in color, with detailing that suggests a textured or patterned surface in the central section, where a darker, crosshatched or diamond-like design is visible. At one end of the band is a rounded, ornate clasp or attachment fixture with decorative, swirling elements, also rendered in gold. The opposite end of the band has a circular, gold mounting that holds a silver or gray star-shaped wheel or rowel with sharp points radiating outward, featuring circular cutouts and additional small protrusions on its surface. Shadows and highlights are used to suggest the object’s metallic sheen and three-dimensional form.
title: Spur
